## 维护者速读
- 是什么：抽屉顶部 ☆ 收藏会话；收藏的会话出现在侧边栏「收藏」，点开在原地的抽屉里接着问，不跳页。

## Background (verified)
- Favourites exist for records etc.: record ☆, sidebar group, Cmd+K; stored in user state `ui.favorites`; types are object/dashboard/page/report/record/view/nav, no conversation; `href` required; max 20 (`context/FavoritesProvider.tsx:46-62,144`).

## What to do
1. Add a `conversation` type to `FavoritesProvider`: conversation id, title, agent; `href` points at the conversation URL as a fallback.
2. ☆ in the drawer header (C4 (#37860) leaves its slot).
3. Sidebar favourite rows get a non-link activation path: a conversation favourite calls `control.open({agent, conversationId})` and opens in place (no navigation, not full screen).
4. Deleted or unreadable conversation → the entry shows as stale and can be removed.
5. Title follows the conversation's latest title; focus is read back from `metadata` (C6 (objectstack-ai/cloud#5113)).

## Acceptance
- Favourite → sidebar; clicking it opens the drawer in place on that conversation; stale entries handled; limit 20 respected.
